target.rawSql:
SELECT
  e.timestamp AS time,
  e.event_type || ' — ' || sc.name ||
    COALESCE(' (' || mcm.code || COALESCE(', ' || mp.code, '') || ')', '') AS text,
  e.event_type AS tags
FROM mpp_connection_event e
JOIN mpp_tracking_slot s ON s.id = e.mpp_tracking_slot_id
JOIN mpp_tracker t ON t.id = s.mpp_tracker_id
JOIN solar_cell sc ON sc.id = e.solar_cell_id
LEFT JOIN mpp_connection_mode mcm ON mcm.id = e.mode_id
LEFT JOIN mpp_polarity mp ON mp.id = e.polarity_id
WHERE t.name = '$tracker'
  AND s.slot_code = '$slot'
  AND e.event_type = 'connection'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.timestamp)

description: Per-slot deep dive — raw voltage/current/power for a single MPP tracking slot, independent of which cell is currently mounted, with connect/disconnect events marked on the timeline.

panels.title: Slot Status — $tracker / $slot
panels.description: Current occupant and connection state, from mpp_tracker_status()

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  slot_code       AS "Slot",
  is_connected    AS "Connected",
  cell_name       AS "Cell",
  mode_code       AS "Mode",
  polarity_code   AS "Polarity",
  connected_since AS "Connected Since"
FROM mpp_tracker_status('$tracker')
WHERE slot_code = '$slot'

panels.title: Power Over Time
panels.description: Raw MPP power measured on this slot, regardless of which cell was mounted. Orange markers show connect/disconnect events.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms, f.timestamp) AS time,
  AVG(f.power) AS "Power"
FROM mpp_measurement_flat f
WHERE f.tracker_name = '$tracker'
  AND f.slot_code = '$slot'
  AND $__timeFilter(f.timestamp)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Voltage & Current
panels.description: Voltage (left axis) and current (right axis) for this slot

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms, f.timestamp) AS time,
  AVG(f.voltage) AS "Voltage (V)",
  AVG(f.current) AS "Current (A)"
FROM mpp_measurement_flat f
WHERE f.tracker_name = '$tracker'
  AND f.slot_code = '$slot'
  AND $__timeFilter(f.timestamp)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Connection Events — $tracker / $slot
panels.description: Every connect/disconnect event ever recorded for this slot, newest first. Independent of the dashboard time range — events are sparse (only on reassignment) so a range filter would hide them whenever the slot was last touched outside the visible window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  e.timestamp             AS "When",
  e.event_type             AS "Event",
  sc.name                  AS "Cell",
  COALESCE(mcm.code, '—')  AS "Mode",
  COALESCE(mp.code, '—')   AS "Polarity"
FROM mpp_connection_event e
JOIN mpp_tracking_slot s ON s.id = e.mpp_tracking_slot_id
JOIN mpp_tracker t       ON t.id = s.mpp_tracker_id
JOIN solar_cell sc       ON sc.id = e.solar_cell_id
LEFT JOIN mpp_connection_mode mcm ON mcm.id = e.mode_id
LEFT JOIN mpp_polarity mp   ON mp.id = e.polarity_id
WHERE t.name = '$tracker'
  AND s.slot_code = '$slot'
ORDER BY e.timestamp DESC
